زَخَّةٌ : see مَزَخَّةٌ. ＝
-A2- Also, (S, L,) and ↓ زَخٌّ , (L,) [or the former is a simple subst. and the latter is an inf. n., (see 1, last sentence but one,)] Rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite; and anger, or rage: (S, L:) but زَخَّةٌ is said to have been heard in this sense only in a verse of Sakhrel-Gheí. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
